1: // Asteroid Dodge – improved graphics
2: // Targets canvas with id "game" in the host HTML
3: 
4: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6: // Audio setup
7: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8: function beep(freq, duration) {
9:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:   osc.type = 'sine';
13:   osc.connect(gain);
14:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:   osc.start();
17:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
18: }
19: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
20: // Create starfield background
21: const stars = [];
22: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
23:   stars.push({
24:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
25:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
26:     size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
27:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
28:   });
29: }
30: function drawStars() {
31:   ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
32:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
33:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
34:   stars.forEach(s => {
35:     ctx.beginPath();
36:     ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
37:     ctx.fill();
38:   });
39: }
40: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
41: 
42: // Player ship
43: const ship = {
44:   x: canvas.width / 2,
45:   y: canvas.height - 50,
46:   w: 30,
47:   h: 30,
48:   speed: 5,
49:   draw() {
50:     // Draw triangular ship
51:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
52:     ctx.beginPath();
53:     ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.h / 2);
54:     ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.w / 2, this.y + this.h / 2);
55:     ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y + this.h / 2);
56:     ctx.closePath();
57:     ctx.fill();
58:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
59:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
60:     ctx.stroke();
61:   }
62: };
63: 
64: let keys = {};
65: let audioStarted = false;
66: function ensureAudio(){ if (!audioStarted) { audioCtx.resume(); audioStarted = true; } }
67: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {keys[e.key] = true; ensureAudio();});
68: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {keys[e.key] = false;});
69: 
70: // Asteroids
71: let asteroids = [];
72: function spawnAsteroid() {
73:   // Play spawn sound
74:   beep(300, 80);
75:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
76:   asteroids.push({
77:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size) + size / 2,
78:     y: -size,
79:     r: size / 2,
80:     speed: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
81:     angle: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
82:     rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02,
83:     draw() {
84:       ctx.save();
85:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
86:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
87:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, this.r * 0.2, 0, 0, this.r);
88:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#bbb');
89:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
90:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
91:       ctx.beginPath();
92:       ctx.arc(0, 0, this.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
93:       ctx.fill();
94:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#222';
95:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
96:       ctx.stroke();
97:       ctx.restore();
98:     }
99:   });
100: }
101: let spawnTimer = 0;
102: 
103: // Simple timer (seconds)
104: let timeLeft = 60; // 60‑second game
105: let lastSecond = Date.now();
106: 
107: function update(dt) {
108:   // Move ship
109:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
110:   if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
111:   if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.y -= ship.speed;
112:   if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.y += ship.speed;
113:   // Clamp inside canvas
114:   ship.x = Math.max(ship.w / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w / 2, ship.x));
115:   ship.y = Math.max(ship.h / 2, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h / 2, ship.y));
116: 
117:   // Spawn asteroids
118:   spawnTimer += dt;
119:   if (spawnTimer > 0.5) { // every 0.5 s
120:     spawnAsteroid();
121:     spawnTimer = 0;
122:   }
123: 
124:   // Update asteroids
125:   for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
126:     const a = asteroids[i];
127:     a.y += a.speed;
128:     a.angle += a.rotSpeed;
129:     // Remove off‑screen
130:     if (a.y - a.r > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
131:     // Collision detection (circle‑rect)
132:     const dx = Math.abs(a.x - ship.x);
133:     const dy = Math.abs(a.y - ship.y);
134:     if (dx > (ship.w / 2 + a.r) || dy > (ship.h / 2 + a.r)) continue;
135:     if (dx <= ship.w / 2 || dy <= ship.h / 2) {
136:       endGame();
137:       return;
138:     }
139:     const cornerDistSq = (dx - ship.w / 2) ** 2 + (dy - ship.h / 2) ** 2;
140:     if (cornerDistSq <= a.r ** 2) { endGame(); return; }
141:   }
142: 
143:   // Timer countdown
144:   const now = Date.now();
145:   if (now - lastSecond >= 1000) {
146:     timeLeft--;
147:     lastSecond = now;
148:     if (timeLeft <= 0) endGame();
149:   }
150: }
151: 
152: function draw() {
153:   // Background starfield
154:   drawStars();
155:   // Update star positions for a slight drift effect
156:   stars.forEach(s => {
157:     s.y += s.speed;
158:     if (s.y > canvas.height) {
159:       s.y = 0;
160:       s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
161:     }
162:   });
163: 
164:   ship.draw();
165:   asteroids.forEach(a => a.draw());
166:   // HUD
167:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:   ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
169:   ctx.fillText('Time: ' + timeLeft, 10, 30);
170: }
171: 
172: let lastTime = 0;
173: let gameOver = false;
174: function loop(timestamp) {
175:   if (gameOver) return;
176:   const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000;
177:   lastTime = timestamp;
178:   update(dt);
179:   draw();
180:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
181: }
182: function endGame() {
183:   // Play crash sound
184:   beep(120, 300);
185:   gameOver = true;
186:   ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
187:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
188:   ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
189:   ctx.font = '40px sans-serif';
190:   ctx.textAlign = 'center';
191:   ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
192: }
193: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
